name: Munden Farm
tagline: Agriculture: A longtime farmer, a strawberry field and good neighbors
description: Munden Farm grows Strawberries, Pumpkins, Corn, and Asparagus in Anne Road, VA. The farm is working, and its seasons run through spring and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in spring. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
